summary: Tested Admin Customer Intelligence Center backend + frontend flows. Core feature set works (admin login, route mapping, overview/detail endpoints, unauthorized rejection, UI panels/list/drawer/map), with one critical auth CORS preflight header regression still present.

critical.issue: Credentialed CORS preflight response is missing access-control-allow-credentials=true and explicit allow-origin in observed deployed response.

action_items: Fix CORS preflight behavior for /api/auth/login so credentialed requests return explicit access-control-allow-origin and access-control-allow-credentials=true.
Retest CORS contract after edge/ingress or middleware adjustment.
critical_code_review_comments: admin_customer_intelligence route correctly excludes Mongo _id from returned event payloads and no ObjectId serialization leaks were observed in tested contracts.
Route alias mapping in App.js for /admin/customer-intelligence and /admin/customer-map to customer-intelligence tab is implemented and working in UI run.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Admin customer intelligence UI flow passed end-to-end via /login -> /admin/customer-intelligence and /admin/customer-map; verified summary cards, map panel/legend/markers, yearly/monthly panels, searchable list, customer drawer open/close. Backend overview/detail contracts and admin/non-admin authorization checks passed. Remaining blocker is auth preflight CORS header contract in deployed response.
rca of the issue: Likely edge/ingress-level preflight handling (or middleware mismatch) strips/overrides credentialed CORS headers on OPTIONS /api/auth/login. Repro: send OPTIONS with Origin + Access-Control-Request-Method/Headers and inspect response headers; access-control-allow-credentials header is empty/missing in this environment.
